title: In oapvd_vlc_metadata of oapv_vlc.c, there is a possible memory corruption due to a double free. (CVE-2026-58968)
description: A double free vulnerability exists in the function oapvd_vlc_metadata within the oapv_vlc.c source file. This memory corruption flaw could allow remote escalation of privilege without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
